Her radio beeps. Quickly, she answers it. "Officer Petroska, status report." A voice on the other end of the line says.

"PT220, status clear. No signs of criminal activity here, sir." Sylvana replies. "Good, keep watching." The chief replies. "Signing off."

Sylvana sighs as she puts back the radio in it's holster. She observes the surrounding area. "Niente occhi indiscreti. Molto bene, hihi..."

With a smirk, and a faint blush, she undoes a few buttons on her uniform, slowly revealing her cleavage. "Ah... much better.." Sylvana says as she leans against a wall.
